dict.string: MacShell shows and manages your Bluetooth devices in your shell.
MacShell measures audio levels so your shell can show volume meters and visualizers.
MacShell measures microphone levels so your shell can show input meters.
MacShell reads what Spotify and Music are playing so your shell can show and control it.
macOS only reveals Wi-Fi network names to apps with location access. MacShell uses it to list nearby networks.
